about.title: About AMMA
about.subtitle: Advancing Health, Guided by Faith.
about.mission: To foster professional growth, ethical practice, and community service among Muslim healthcare professionals in the United States, providing a unified voice for excellence and compassion.
about.vision: A future where Muslim healthcare professionals lead the way in clinical excellence, ethical innovation, and health equity for all communities.
about.history: Founded in 1998 by a small group of visionary physicians in Chicago, AMMA has grown into a nationwide network of over 15,000 members across 42 chapters.

values.title: Ihsan (Excellence)
values.description: Striving for the highest quality in clinical care and professional conduct.

values.title: Rahma (Compassion)
values.description: Treating every patient with empathy and dignity, as a reflection of our faith.

values.title: Unity
values.description: Fostering a supportive network for professionals at every stage of their career.

values.title: Service
values.description: Dedication to humanitarian relief and local community health outreach.

chapters.title: Local Chapters
chapters.subtitle: Connecting Professionals in Your Community.
chapters.description: AMMA operates through a vibrant network of regional chapters, each serving as a hub for local networking, mentorship, and community service.

specialties.title: Specialty Sections
specialties.subtitle: Expertise Shared Within Our Network.
specialties.description: AMMA hosts dedicated specialty sections where professionals can share research, discuss complex cases, and collaborate on specialty-specific health initiatives.

membershipInfo.title: Membership Benefits
membershipInfo.subtitle: Invest in Your Future and Your Community.
membershipInfo.description: Joining AMMA is more than a professional credential—it's a commitment to growth, networking, and service.

benefits.title: Networking

benefits.title: Mentorship

benefits.description: Access accredited CME webinars and discounts on our annual conventions.

tiers.name: Physicians & Dentists
tiers.description: Includes Physicians (MD/DO), Dentists (DDS/DMD), Podiatrists (DPM), Optometrists (OD), Veterinarians (DVM), and International physicians/dentists.
